reviews.title: Scam
reviews.text: Do not purchase this app. I have sent several photos showing unhealthy plants/leaves and each time after submitting the photo it comes back stating the plant is healthy. I would really like to get my money back. I should have researched more.

reviews.title: Not helpful
reviews.text: The app said it will help identify and help my plant may or may not need and every picture says healthy. But I put a picture of a dead plant and it said healthy. A waste of money.

reviews.title: The leaves on my fig tree are clearly wilting
reviews.text: The app identified the plant as healthy, which I don’t believe is true
